parameters.label: Words on the button face.
parameters.onPressed: Runs the action. Pass null to disable it.
parameters.size: Selects a small, medium or large button.
parameters.wide: Stretches the face to the available width.
parameters.icon: Adds a glyph to the component.
parameters.leading: Places a widget before the label.
parameters.busy: Suppresses activation while the action is in progress.
parameters.showBusy: Overrides whether the busy indicator is visible.
parameters.focusNode: Supplies the FocusNode owned by the caller.
parameters.autofocus: Requests keyboard focus when the control first appears.
